final: WITH teams AS (SELECT DISTINCT team_id FROM team), mh AS (SELECT team_id, CAST(w AS REAL) / g AS wr FROM manager_half WHERE g > 0 AND w IS NOT NULL), team_stats AS (SELECT t.team_id, (SELECT AVG(wr) FROM mh WHERE mh.team_id = t.team_id) AS avg_wr, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manager_half m WHERE m.team_id = t.team_id) AS n FROM teams t), mean_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wr) AS m FROM team_stats) SELECT ts.team_id, ts.avg_wr, ts.n, ts.avg_wr - ma.m AS diff FROM team_stats ts CROSS JOIN mean_avg ma WHERE ma.m IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10
